text:
Nico Hischier just reached 500 career points, and he's the kind of center whose numbers keep getting better the closer you look. New Jersey takes 61% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice. When the Devils need to settle a game, The Hockey News noted, Sheldon Keefe sends out the Hischier line.

The scoring (8 goals, 13 points in 19 games) is exactly what his chances say; his finishing is dead on his expected goals. If anything, the assists are light, because the Devils have scored about 3.5 fewer goals than expected with him on. Last season was the same story: Evolving-Hockey had him in the 96th percentile for driving offense and better than his goals.

A small signature from Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking: 20% of his setups come from behind the net, more than twice a typical forward's rate. Our range has him at 21 to 35 goals for the season.
